clues.text: This compact wooden roller coaster reaches a modest height of 55 feet and a top speed of 45 mph with zero inversions.
Manufactured by Custom Coasters International (CCI), this ride made its official debut in 2001.
You can find this ride delighting visitors at an amusement park located in the state of Indiana.
Famous for being shoehorned into tight spaces, its layout weaves right through the structure of another wooden coaster and wraps around the park's Tig'rr Coaster.
The ride's name sounds like a high-speed transit train dedicated to an overly cheesy, sentimental joke.

evidence.quote: Cornball Express is a wooden roller coaster at Indiana Beach amusement park in Monticello, Indiana, United States.
Cornball Express, as with other rides at the park, is also notable for being 'shoehorned' into other rides at the park.
